definitions.explanation: A feeling of not being satisfied or pleased with something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不満|ふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{不満|ふまん}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They have a dissatisfied look on their face.

notes:
{不満|ふまん} functions as both a na-adjective and a noun. It is formed by adding the negative prefix {不|ふ} to {満足|まんぞく} (satisfaction).

FORMS:
- {不満|ふまん}な + noun: {不満|ふまん}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (dissatisfied expression)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不満|ふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have complaints about ~
- {不満|ふまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to voice complaints
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不満|ふまん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: to be dissatisfied with ~
- {不満|ふまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to harbor dissatisfaction

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不満|ふまん}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a dissatisfied-looking face
- {不満|ふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧: frustration builds up
- {不満|ふまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧: to let dissatisfaction slip out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不満|ふまん}: general dissatisfaction (broad)
- ⟦{不平|ふへい}→不平：03602_fuhei⟧: grievance, complaint (often paired: {不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん})
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧: formal complaint (to a company, authority)
